title: OrderItem - Order Module Data Models Reference

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the OrderItem data model. It belongs to the Order Module.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the order item.

types.name: version
types.description: The version that the order item belongs to.

types.name: unit_price
types.description: The unit price of the order item

types.name: compare_at_unit_price
types.description: The original price of the item before a promotion or sale.

types.name: quantity
types.description: The quantity of the order item

types.name: fulfilled_quantity
types.description: The fulfilled quantity of the order item

types.name: delivered_quantity
types.description: The delivered quantity of the order item

types.name: shipped_quantity
types.description: The shipped quantity of the order item

types.name: return_requested_quantity
types.description: The quantity requested to be returned.

types.name: return_received_quantity
types.description: The quantity received by a return.

types.name: return_dismissed_quantity
types.description: The quantity dismissed by a return.

types.name: written_off_quantity
types.description: The quantity written off by an order edit.

types.name: metadata
types.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.
